notes: §2002:7.2.19.2 SR2 'Exception-name-1 shall be one of the exception names listed in 14.5.12.1, Exception conditions'. EcInfo.IntroducedIn is now the first edition whose own list names the exception-name (kb/Work PB5703): EC-FUNCTION and its children, EC-BOUND-SET, EC-BOUND-TABLE-LIMIT, EC-DATA-NOT-FINITE, EC-DATA-OVERFLOW, EC-FLOW-SEARCH and EC-OO-ARG-OMITTED are 2014, EC-BOUND-FUNC-RET-VALUE and EC-FUNCTION-IMP are 2023; ExceptionCatalogEditionDriftTests reads the three transcriptions and holds every catalog name to it. Run at --std 2002 with this build: '>>TURN EC-FUNCTION CHECKING ON' and '>>TURN EC-BOUND-SET CHECKING ON' are refused COBOL0878 (introduced by 2014), where before they compiled.
